{{Top|leg}}
'''Hornweed''' was a [[Tree/Legends|tree]]-like [[Plant/Legends|plant]] which grew in the [[Gungan Swamp|swamps]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Hornweed fibers were used by the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] to form strong, resilient [[Bow/Legends|bows]] and arms for their [[Gungan catapult/Legends|catapults]].
